description:
## [3.11.1](https://github.com/crimera/piko/compare/v3.11.0...v3.11.1) (2026-11-10)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Instagram:** Spoof patched app signature to match original app ([#2281](https://github.com/crimera/piko/issues/2281)) ([47d8af4](https://github.com/crimera/piko/commit/47d8af42553dc2e5218e740834fee8e79da49e57))

patches.name: Add settings
patches.description: Adds settings to control preferences are patching

patches.name: Change like animation
patches.description: Change the animation to one from existing Rings like animations

patches.name: Clone
patches.description: Changes the package name and the app name. This allows you to install the patched app alongside the original Instagram app.

options.description: A new package name for the patched app.
A new app name (label). Entering "Instagram" will skip changing the app name.

patches.name: Copy comment
patches.description: Adds buttons to copy comments and their authors' usernames on posts and reels.

patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Adds an option to replace the app font with a font file from the device storage.

patches.name: Custom sharing domain
patches.description: Allows for using custom domains when sharing posts, reels and stories.

patches.name: Customise story timestamp
patches.description: Customise the timestamp that shows when the story was posted

patches.name: Customize navigation bar
patches.description: Choose which tabs appear in the bottom navigation bar and reorder them

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Disables Play Store updates by setting the version code to the maximum allowed. This patch may cause unexpected issues with some apps and does not work if the app is installed by root mounting

patches.name: Disable Reels scrolling
patches.description: Disables the endless scrolling behavior in Instagram Reels, preventing swiping to the next Reel. Note: On a clean install, the 'Tip' animation may appear but will stop on its own after a few seconds.

patches.name: Disable comments
patches.description: Disables comments and hides comment buttons on posts, reels and stories

patches.name: Disable disappearing messages swipe
patches.description: Prevents swiping up in a chat from enabling disappearing messages

patches.name: Disable discover people
patches.description: Hides suggested accounts

patches.name: Disable double tap like
patches.description: Disable double tap like on post, reel, comment and message

patches.name: Disable screenshot detection
patches.description: Disables screenshots detection in DM

patches.name: Disable story flipping
patches.description: Disable automatic flipping/moving to next story

patches.name: Disable swipe to create
patches.description: Prevents opening the creation screen by swiping right on the home tab.

patches.name: Download media
patches.description: Adds ability to download posts, reels, stories and highlights

patches.name: Download voice message
patches.description: Enables ability to download voice messages

patches.name: External downloader
patches.description: Adds support to share post links directly to external downloader

patches.name: Filter stories
patches.description: Filter stories to hide based on different categories

patches.name: Focus Lock
patches.description: Commitment mode for cutting down on Instagram. Pick what to block (Reels, Explore) and a duration; once locked those protections are forced on and cannot be switched off. Reels shared with you still open. Unlocking early requires a 24 hour cooling-off period, and resetting or importing settings is blocked while locked.

patches.name: Friendship status indicator
patches.description: Adds a follows you back status label on the profile page and shows a detailed friendship status breakdown on click

patches.name: Hidden chats
patches.description: Adds an option to the chat menu that moves the chat to a private inbox, opened by tapping the messages button several times.

patches.name: Hide Reels follow button
patches.description: Removes the follow button from Reels.

patches.name: Hide feed posts
patches.description: Hides posts from the home feed

patches.name: Hide group creation button on sharesheet
Hide hidden requests
patches.description: Hides the hidden requests (spam) button in the message requests page

patches.name: Hide like buttons
patches.description: Hides like buttons on posts, reels and stories

patches.name: Hide notes tray
patches.description: Hides notes tray in DM section

patches.name: Hide reshare button
patches.description: Hides the reshare button from both posts and reels.

patches.name: Hide save buttons
patches.description: Hides save buttons on posts and reels

patches.name: Hide share button
patches.description: Hides the share button on posts, reels and stories

patches.name: Hide stories tray
patches.description: Hides stories tray from main feed.

patches.name: Hide story follow button
patches.description: Hides the follow button at the top of stories.

patches.name: Hide suggested content
patches.description: Hides suggested stories, reels, threads (Suggested posts will still be shown).

patches.name: Improve image viewing
patches.description: Fetches max resolution images from server.

patches.name: Inbox lock
patches.description: Asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock before the inbox is shown.

patches.name: Limit feed to following profiles
patches.description: Filters the home feed to display only content from profiles you follow.

patches.name: Loop story
patches.description: Replay the current story when it ends

patches.name: Make ephemeral media permanent
patches.description: Changes unexpired view once, view twice media to permanent view.

patches.name: Mark as read after reply
patches.description: Adds an option to mark chats as read after replying while viewing DMs anonymously.

patches.name: Mark chat as read manually
patches.description: Adds option to mark a thread aka message as read manually

patches.name: More options on post
patches.description: Adds an overflow menu button to get more options on post/reels, like copy description, copy username etc

patches.name: More options on profile
patches.description: Adds a new button to handle user related data like copy handle, download profile picture etc

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Changes links to always open in your external browser, instead of the in-app browser.

patches.name: Recommended flags
patches.description: Developer flags suggested by the community

patches.name: Remove empty bottom space
patches.description: Removes empty space below bottom navigation bar

patches.name: Resume Reels after scrolling
patches.description: Resumes videos from where you left off when you scroll back to them in Reels

patches.name: Save Instants
patches.description: Captures view-once Instants as you view them so you can re-view and download them later.

patches.name: Save deleted messages
patches.description: Captures incoming DMs locally as they arrive from the server and marks them when the sender deletes them.

patches.name: Save media comment
patches.description: Adds a button to save media comments on posts and reels.

patches.name: Theme
patches.description: Adds Material You and AMOLED controls to Piko settings on Android 12 and later. On Android 8–11, it applies a fixed Material You-style theme or an optional AMOLED theme.

options.description: Use a fixed pure-black AMOLED theme instead of the fixed Material You-style theme on Android 8–11. On Android 12 and later, use the AMOLED control in Piko settings.

patches.name: Unlock developer options
patches.description: Unlocks developer option by long pressing home icon

patches.name: View story mentions
patches.description: Add option to view visible and hidden story mentions.

patches.name: Add ability to copy media link
Block redirecting to X Lite
patches.description: Blocks redirecting to the new X Android UI on launch

patches.name: Block update screen
patches.description: Blocks the 'This app is out of date' update screen from being shown on launch

patches.name: Bring back twitter
patches.description: Bring back old twitter logo and name

patches.name: Clear tracking params
patches.description: Removes tracking parameters when sharing links

patches.name: Control video auto scroll
patches.description: Control video auto scroll in immersive view

patches.name: Custom download folder
patches.description: Change the download directory for video downloads

patches.name: Custom emoji font
patches.description: Customise emoji font style

patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Customise font style

patches.name: Custom share menu
patches.description: Overrides existing share menu and adds a new one

patches.name: Custom sharing domain
patches.description: Allows for using domains like fxtwitter when sharing tweets/posts.

patches.name: Delete from database
patches.description: Delete entries from database(cache)

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Disables Play Store updates by setting the version code to the maximum allowed. This patch may cause unexpected issues with some apps and does not work if the app is installed by root mounting

patches.name: Disable auto timeline scroll on launch
Download patch
patches.description: Unlocks the ability to download videos and gifs from Twitter/X

patches.name: Dynamic color
patches.description: Replaces the default Twitter Blue with the user's Material You palette.

patches.name: Enable PiP mode automatically
patches.description: Enables PiP mode when you close the app

patches.name: Enable Undo Posts
patches.description: Enables ability to undo posts before posting

patches.name: Enable force HD videos
patches.description: Videos will be played in highest quality always

patches.name: Export all activities
patches.description: Makes all app activities exportable.

patches.name: Force enable translate
patches.description: Get translate option for all posts

patches.name: Handle custom twitter links
patches.description: Adds support for opening custom twitter links such as vxtwitter, fxtwitter, and fixupx within the app. These will have to be manually enabled under the "Open by default" section in the app info!

options.description: The custom sharing domains to register to be opened in Twitter

patches.name: Hide Banner
patches.description: Hide new post banner

patches.name: Hide FAB
patches.description: Adds an option to hide Floating action button

patches.name: Hide Recommended Users
patches.description: Hide recommended users that pops up when you follow someone

patches.name: Hide badges from navigation bar icons
patches.description: Hides notification nudges & counts from navigation bar icons

patches.name: Hide followed by context
patches.description: Hides followed by context under profile

patches.name: Hide immersive player
patches.description: Removes swipe up for more videos in video player

patches.name: Hide nudge button
patches.description: Hides follow/subscribe/follow back buttons on posts

patches.name: Hide post metrics
patches.description: Hides like, reposts etc counts.

patches.name: Hide promote button
patches.description: Hides promote button under self posts

patches.name: Hide recommendation items
patches.description: Adds options to hide recommendation items such as "Who to follow" and "Today's news" in timeline, search, and replies.

patches.name: Import/Export login token
patches.description: Adds an feature to export and import the token of accounts. This is useful when logging in on your second device or when re-installing piko.

patches.name: Legacy share links
patches.description: Brings back username on post share links. Works post 11.4x.xx

patches.name: Log server response
patches.description: Log json responses received from server

patches.name: More information on profile
patches.description: Adds more details on the profile page

patches.name: Native downloader
patches.description: Requires X 11.0.0-release.0 or higher.

patches.name: Native reader mode
patches.description: Requires X 11.0.0-release.0 or higher.

patches.name: Native translator
patches.description: Requires X 11.0.0-release.0 or higher.

patches.name: No shortened URL
patches.description: Get rid of t.co short urls.

patches.name: Pause search suggestions
patches.description: Search suggestions will not be saved locally

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removed promoted posts, trends and google ads

patches.name: Remove premium upsell
patches.description: Removes premium upsells

patches.name: Remove search suggestions
patches.description: Hide/Remove search suggestion in explore section

patches.name: Remove view count
patches.description: Removes the view count from the bottom of tweets

patches.name: Restore legacy follower lists
patches.description: Restores the legacy follower and following list screen.

patches.name: Round off numbers
patches.description: Enable or disable rounding off numbers

patches.name: Selectable Text
patches.description: Makes bio and username selectable

patches.name: Share Tweet as Image
patches.description: Share tweets as rendered image. Requires X 11.0.0-release.0 or higher.

patches.name: Show changelogs
patches.description: Shows changelogs when new a patch is installed.

patches.name: Show poll results
patches.description: Adds an option to show poll results without voting

patches.name: Show post source label
patches.description: Source label will be shown only on public posts
